messages:
Anita (Sales): Passing KeyWave to CS — signed today, 3-month pilot, expects early API integration. Quick context: currently on hosted API but asking for Private eval. Primary contacts: maya@keywave.com (CTO), rafael@keywave.com (SRE). Estimated ramp: 10k tokens/day -> 200k/day in 30d. Renewal window at end of 90d. Potential risk: SSO + VPC requirement may delay go-live.

Jules (CS): Thanks Anita — adding owners. Can you confirm billing contact and any PHI/PII scope? Do they require Dedicated/Dedicated-Plus or full Private (VPC/on-prem)?

Anita (Sales): Billing is finance@keywave.com. They indicated PHI-ish documents in prompts — leaning Private/VPC. Sales recommended initial Dedicated capacity (4 GPU equiv) while we evaluate Private. They also asked for Okta SSO + SCIM. No SOC2 docs shared yet.

Jules (CS): Ok. I'll start the onboarding runbook. Owners: Jules — onboarding lead; Riley — support lead; Sam — eng escalation. ETA for provisioning: ~5 business days if infra clear.

Riley (Support): Noted. I'll need: API keys in staging, a small sanitized prompt set for quality checks, and access to their staging ingress logs for any tracebacks.

Sam (Eng): If they go VPC, we need SRE coordination for IP allowlist/private link and route table changes. Also: what's latency SLO?

Anita (Sales): They want <200ms median for generation at ~512 tokens.

Sam (Eng): That's achievable on Dedicated. I'll draft a capacity estimate (4x A100 equiv or 2x H100 equiv). Posting infra note to the ticket and tagging @infra-team.

Jules (CS): Next steps: 1) Share onboarding packet (link posted: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/keywave) 2) Create ticket ONB-7890 (created) 3) Schedule kickoff with KeyWave — target Mon 9am PT 4) Preflight: SSO (Okta), VPC peering, KMS choice, data retention policy. Owners inline on ticket.

Deploy-bot: Ticket ONB-7890 created by Jules. SLA target: 7 days.

Riley (Support): I'll draft the runbook checks and add a monitoring dashboard template (alerts: error rate, 95p latency, token burn). Need sanitized eval prompts from Sales by EOD Thu.

Maya (KeyWave): Thanks everyone — I'll send sample prompts and SCIM metadata today. CC'ing Rafael (SRE) and finance. We prefer AWS KMS and Okta SAML metadata available.

Jules (CS): Added Maya to the kickoff invite. Renewal-risk notes: SSO + VPC are the main blockers — risk = Yellow. Recommended mitigations: 1) priority infra queue 2) AE assist for SSO mapping 3) weekly CS sync with KeyWave.

Anita (Sales): Sales will prepare an SOW addendum for Private deployment costs and share with finance.

Sam (Eng): For SSO we'll need Okta metadata (issuer, cert). For KMS we support AWS KMS; if they require on-prem HSM that's an escalation. Please indicate KMS key alias and CMK ARN when ready.

Jules (CS): I'll own customer status updates on the dashboard and post weekly summaries in #customer-success. Closing ask: everyone acknowledge ownership and update ONB-7890 with deliverables and ETA.

Riley (Support): Ack — I'll attach the monitoring template and onboarding checklist to ONB-7890 and add a preflight validation step.

Anita (Sales): Ack — I'll confirm finance contact and send the SOW addendum draft by EOD Friday.

Maya (KeyWave): Sending SCIM metadata and sample prompts now. Initial team for kickoff: Maya (CTO), Rafael (SRE), Priya (PM). Looking forward to Monday.

Jules (CS): Great — thanks all. I'll post a short summary after kickoff and move the ticket through provisioning steps.
